# SwiftShare Release

SwiftShare is an open-source local Wi-Fi file sharing desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

## Downloads

The installers are attached to this release after the build completes:

- Windows: download the `.exe` installer.
- macOS: download the `.dmg` image.
- Linux: download the `.deb` package.

## Notes

- No internet or central server is required for transfers.
- Devices must be on the same local network.
- Project repository: https://github.com/mozaddedalfeshani/swiftshare
